texts.title: Past Thesis Explorer
texts.tagline: Explore {count} thesis topics from previous EU-HEM cohorts.
texts.intro: Looking for inspiration? Browse thesis topics completed by previous EU-HEM students across health economics, management, policy, global health and healthcare research.
texts.historical: Historical archive. These thesis topics come from earlier EU-HEM cohorts ({cohortRange}), when the programme used a different six-track structure. Historical track labels do not correspond exactly to the current four-track programme.
texts.historicalSmall: Use these topics as inspiration and examples of the breadth of EU-HEM research, not as a list of currently available thesis topics.
texts.inspirationTitle: Use past topics as inspiration, not templates to copy.
texts.inspiration: These titles show the breadth of EU-HEM research. A strong thesis addresses a relevant question, uses an appropriate method, and contributes something distinct from previous work. Always discuss feasibility and originality with your supervisor.
texts.ownThesis: In the current programme the thesis is written in Semester 4 at one of the two universities of your track.
texts.ownThesisOfficial: For thesis rules, topics and supervisors, follow the official information from EU-HEM and your thesis university.
texts.source: Source: a list of thesis topics shared by a previous EU-HEM student. It is not an official or complete archive, reflects an older track structure, and is provided for orientation and inspiration.
texts.sourceContact: Is a title wrong, or would you like a title removed?
texts.cardNote: This archive contains only the title, cohort, track and university. It does not include the abstract, method, supervisor or full text.
texts.notAvailable: Not every thesis is publicly available.
